review.notes: Per-page text-layer comparison of all 65 physical PDF pages against the OCR markdown (normalized), with rendered-page verification on physical pages 2, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 25, 30, 31, 37, 40, 41, 44 and 64 at 110-320 dpi. Dominant defect: all 33 numbered footnote bodies were dropped while the inline superscript markers survived; each body was transcribed from a rendered bottom-strip crop and restored after the paragraph carrying its marker (patches group footnotes sharing one anchor line). Two list bullets ('Reformatted datasets', 'Synthetic datasets') were promoted to headings by OCR and are demoted. No code fences exist in the OCR markdown. Chart/figure-internal labels (bar charts on pages 2, 10-13, 27, 32, 38, 42, 45, 47, 49), the page-1 copyright line and page numbers are page/figure furniture and were left unchanged. The Tables 6 and 11 values, references section and inline math all match the PDF text layer; suspected prose drops on pages 18, 23, 30, 31, 33, 34, 39, 64 and 65 were confirmed present in the markdown (line-reflow false positives).
